thread:
maya: Starting final launch readiness for payments-v2. Safety cordon (not 'quiet window') for Sat 2025-05-03 00:00–02:00 UTC. Please ack by 08:30 PT if you're green. @sam @jordan @liam

sam: Ack from infra — autoscale groups warmed, AMIs baked, GPU pools warmed.

jordan: QA: staging smoke passed on core flows. Found a small visual regression tracked in #ux-payments (link). Not blocking for canary.

liam: SRE check — dashboards + alerting configs are good. Runbooks are loaded into incidents.playbooks.

maya: Pinning plan: pin production traffic to v3.12.1-prod on dedicated pool before rollout. I'll kick canaries once pin is confirmed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pinned releases/v3.12.1-prod -> dedicated-pool. pin_id=abc123

maya: Canary rollout plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m hold between major steps. Gates: api_errors, p95_latency, 4xx_rate. Manual stop rules: any error-rate >1.5% OR p95 +50% vs baseline OR 4xxs >2x.

sam: Added rollout config: /set-rollout payments-v2 2,10,50,100 20m gates=api_errors,p95_latency,4xx_rate
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary initiated on dedicated-pool; cohort=canary-20250503-1; canary_id=canary-6175312468

jordan: QA running expanded smoke (payments, refunds, session restore). I'll post failures inline. ETA ~10m.

oncall-sre: Oncall here — handover ready. Pager on. If we need an immediate self-serve rollback use: /deploy undo canary-6175312468 or @oncall-sre.

maya: Release notes (skim): https://redwood.internal/releases/payments-v2 — note the quantization profile tweak that could affect embedding consistency for legacy customers.

liam: Infra note: Dedicated has ~10% spare capacity in us-west-2. Auto-burst to shared-tier allowed per policy if we see temporary surge.

jordan: Smoke update: first run OK. Second run: 3x payment-session 504 timeouts (same pattern). Investigating env var mismatch hypothesis.

sam: If 504s persist during canary step, rollback immediately. Manual-rollback threshold: >5x 504 in 5m OR gate triggers.

maya: Decision: if QA can't clear the 10% step within 15m we stop and rollback. I'll hold the freeze-lift until 02:00 UTC if all stable.

release-manager: Ack — added "no-new-feature" freeze tag to changelog and notified PM + support triage.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary metrics update — p95 latency +12% (within gate), error-rate 0.8% (within gate), observed 504 spike: 3 events in 5m. Continuing monitoring.

jordan: Quick mitigation: rolling restart of payment-workers on staging cleared the 504s. Re-running smoke now.

maya: Ops quick-commands (copy into war room if rollback needed):
- /deploy undo canary-6175312468
- /pin releases/v3.11.8 -> dedicated-pool  (previous stable)
- /notify customers group "payments" with status

oncall-sre: Added rollback-quick.sh to ops/playbooks and notified #incidents if invoked.

sam: Infra reports green after restart. QA re-run passed. Proceeding to next step: 50% in 20m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling to 50% now; will report back with metric snapshot in ~4m.

maya: Final note: keep using this thread as audit. If you're leaving shift, handoff to @oncall-sre. Thank you — stay ready for a manual rollback during the cordon. :thumbsup:
